(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of \(Y\) is \(8:19\). Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積比為 \(8:19\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。

By conservation of volume, \[\frac13\pi(18)^2h=9\left(\frac43\pi(6)^3\right).\] Hence \[108\pi h=2592\pi,\] so \[ h=24. \] Therefore, the height of the circular cone is \(24\) cm. (b) The volume ratio is \[V_X:V_Y=8:19,\] so \[V_X:V_{\text{whole cone}}=8:27.\] Thus the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \[\sqrt[3]{\frac8{27}}=\frac23.\] The slant height of the whole cone is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\] Hence the radius and slant height of the smaller cone \(X\) are \[12 \text{and} 20\] respectively. Therefore, the curved surface area of the frustum \(Y\) is \[\pi(18+12)(30-20)=300\pi.\]

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the hemisphere be \(r\) cm. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Given that \[3\pi r^2=432\pi,\] we have \[r^2=144,\] so \[ r=12. \] Therefore, the volume of the hemisphere is \[\frac12\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)\] \[=\frac23\pi(12)^3\] \[=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Let the height of cone \(X\) be \(h\) cm. Since cone \(Y\) and cone \(X\) are similar, the height of cone \(Y\) is \[\frac{10}{14}h=\frac57h.\] Thus the volume of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right).\] Since \(Z\) is recast into the hemisphere, \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right)=1152\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{872}{21}h=1152,\] so \[h=\frac{3024}{109}.\] The height of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac27h=\frac{6048}{763}.\] The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{\left(\frac{6048}{763}\right)^2+(14-10)^2}\] \[\approx 8.878686548.\] Hence the total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(14^2)+\pi(10^2)+\pi(14+10)(8.878686548).\] Therefore, \[\text{total surface area of }Z\approx 1599.35\text{ cm}^2.\] But \[432\pi\approx 1357.17\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[1357.17<1599.35,\] the total surface area of the hemisphere does not exceed the total surface area of \(Z\). (5 marks)

Since the height ratio is \(1:3:4\), the total number of parts is \[1+3+4=8.\] The heights of the upper part, middle part and lower part are \[15\text{ cm}, 45\text{ cm}, 60\text{ cm}\] respectively. By similarity, \[\frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40},\] so \[ r=45. \] The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{75^2+40^2}=85.\] The slant height of cone \(Q\) is \[\sqrt{45^2+24^2}=51.\] Therefore, the slant height of frustum \(P\) is \[85-51=34.\] The curved surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(P\) is \[4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2\] \[=4080\pi+5625\pi+2025\pi =11730\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (4 marks) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac13\pi(45)^2(24)\] \[=75000\pi-16200\pi =58800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) are similar, then the ratio of their volumes should be the cube of the ratio of their corresponding heights. However, \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8,\] while \[\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343}\ne 8.\] Therefore, \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar. (3 marks)
